threads.summary: Child record on JOBID6635896036811872926 (Simpson Housing) resolved a real CT price code instead of Refer to Parent Record. Root cause: parent created ~70s after the child, so the child's price-code logic ran as a standalone job.
threads.note: Adjet's price-code retrigger is still unverified: no Spec Ops job has been created parent-after-children since the fix shipped, so the race has not been re-exercised. Eight jobs created 8/24-8/26 (96866/96917/96920 and siblings) were all created parent-first and all children correctly read Refer to Parent Record. Re-check each run until a job actually hits the race.
